list.title: Orders
list.emptySubline: New orders appear here automatically. Older orders are added by the command “bin/console ordo:order:sync”.

info.title: Control centre: all orders at a glance
info.text: Every order automatically gets an order file; every item has its own status. “Needs action” shows orders waiting for the customer or on hold – e.g. missing artwork or open prepayment. Click the order number to open the file.

filter.actionHelp: At least one item is waiting for the customer (artwork, approval, payment, question) or is on hold.
filter.openHelp: At least one item has not been shipped or cancelled yet.
filter.finishedHelp: All items are shipped, delivered or cancelled.

detail.title: Order {number}
detail.noTransitions: No change possible in this status.
detail.noteHelp: Internal note on the order file, visible to all staff, never to the customer. Example: “Customer will call back tomorrow about the colour”.
detail.notePlaceholder: e.g. customer wants delivery from 15 Dec
detail.reasonHelp: Stored in the log and helps colleagues understand the change. Example: “Customer sent a new file by email”.
detail.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. question about film colour open
detail.errorTransition: The status could not be changed. Please reload the page and try again.
detail.errorNote: The note could not be saved.

info.title: Order file
info.text: Here you see every item with its status. Use “Change status” to move an item on, e.g. from “Artwork check” to “Released”. Only allowed steps are offered. Every change and note is logged with your name.
